rules.dividends: 0050 cash dividends credited to the line's cash on the ex-date

lines.C10: 50% 0050 / 50% cash; decided at each quarter's last trading-day close (Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec), traded next open
lines.C1: 50% 0050 / 50% cash; decided at each month's last trading-day close, traded next open
lines.C8: H = highest 0050 total-return close since day 0; invested 100%: close <= 0.90*H -> next open 40% 0050 / 60% cash; reduced: close >= 0.95*H -> next open 100% 0050; starts 100% invested
lines.VT15: weekly (last session of the week) E = min(1, 0.15 / sigma), sigma = 60-day stdev of daily 0050 total returns x sqrt(252) (pre-day-0 history as warm-up), rounded to 1%; traded next open
